cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(embeddedlib_external_smoke LANGUAGES C)
if(NOT DEFINED EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR is required")
endif()
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_library(embeddedlib_project_options INTERFACE)
target_compile_features(embeddedlib_project_options INTERFACE c_std_11)
add_library(embeddedlib::project_options ALIAS embeddedlib_project_options)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/mizu_status" mizu_status)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/mizu_fifo" mizu_fifo)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/pid" pid)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/cascaded_pid" cascaded_pid)
add_executable(external_components_smoke main.c)
target_link_libraries(external_components_smoke PRIVATE mizu_fifo pid cascaded_pid)
target_compile_features(external_components_smoke PRIVATE c_std_11)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME external.components COMMAND external_components_smoke)
